sources.note: Main Oracle Health landing page. Lists solution areas: Clinical Suite, Financial Operations, Consumer Experience, Population Health, Clinical Operations, Interoperability, Reporting & Analytics, Payer Operations, Security, Continuum of Care. Shows customer logos (Community Health Systems, BayCare, Emirates Health Services, etc.).
Oracle Health EHR product page. Describes AI-embedded, voice-first EHR with personalized workflows, cloud SaaS delivery, and ONC certification. Marketing-focused with limited technical detail.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms EHI export support for single-patient and population-level exports. Links to cost/fee information, API access, real-world testing plans, SVAP documentation, and MFA use cases.
Deep dive into Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium history, architecture, and capabilities. Covers modular design, cloud migration, and comprehensive platform description.
Imprivata knowledge hub entry on Cerner Millennium. Confirms enterprise-grade EHR with identity management integration.
Overview of Cerner Millennium covering modules (PowerChart, PharmNet, PathNet, RadNet, SurgiNet, FirstNet), patient portal (HealtheLife), cost, implementation, and market position.

Comprehensive guide to Cerner EHR applications listing PathNet (lab), RadNet (radiology), SurgiNet (surgery), FirstNet (ED), PharmNet (pharmacy), HealtheAnalytics, Capacity Management, and other modules.
Cerner pharmacy architecture overview describing PharmNet's closed-loop medication management, shared clinical database, and integration with CPOE.
Pharmacy journal article on Cerner Millennium pharmacy module capabilities and medication management workflows.
CHOC's overview of Cerner Patient Accounting module: claims processing, payments, revenue posting, insurance management, financial dashboards.
ROI Healthcare Solutions brochure for Cerner Millennium covering revenue cycle, contract management, capacity management, and analytics modules.

SoftwareConnect product listing for Oracle Health. Lists features: clinical digital assistant AI, medical data collection, communications, public health reporting, referral network, virtual care, med administration, lab/drug alerts, staff shift planning, RCM, document management. Notes high learning curve and non-intuitive UI.
Becker's article on Oracle Health market share decline: 22.9% of acute care hospitals in 2024, down from 25% in 2021. Net loss of 74 hospitals in 2024.
KLAS Research data on 2024 EHR market share. Epic at 42.3%, Oracle Health at 22.9%. Oracle Health had very few new wins (9 in 2024).
CNBC coverage of Epic vs Oracle Health market dynamics. Confirms Oracle Health's declining position and customer retention challenges.
Oracle press release on VA contract extension. Confirms multibillion-dollar federal deployment of Millennium at VA medical centers.
CommunityWorks overview flyer: cloud-based, multi-tenant Millennium for critical access, community, and specialty hospitals with fixed-fee pricing.
Oracle Health Millennium Platform API documentation. FHIR R4 support, developer program, API access information.
Article on Oracle Health EHR enhancements: Clinical AI Agent, cloud innovation, personalized workflows, and UI improvements.
Comprehensive Cerner EMR overview covering ambulatory and inpatient modules, implementation complexity, and user experience challenges.
HealthManagement.org product listing for Cerner FirstNet (ED module): patient tracking, triage, documentation, order entry.
Oracle Health service lines page: oncology, maternity, surgery, pediatrics, and other specialty-specific clinical workflows.
